## Description

Use %K/%D overbought/oversold crossover signals to anticipate short-term reversals.

## Where it may fit

Sideways markets with repeated swing highs and lows.

## Vehicles

Stocks, ETFs, FX and futures.

## Required data

OHLC bars, lookback settings, costs.

## Caveats

Oscillators can remain overbought/oversold during strong trends.
